labels.label: DEMO ADAPTER
labels.title: Demonstration computed from analytic / published formulas or merged lane-F/G code while the owning lane is not merged; not that lane's output

labels.label: NOT AVAILABLE
labels.title: Nothing honest to show yet; see the reason

labels.label: CERTIFIED
labels.title: Every target met by an applicable, independently checked bound

labels.label: INFEASIBLE
labels.title: Applicable bounds exist but targets cannot be met

labels.label: OUT-OF-MODEL
labels.title: Request violates the proof's trust/physical model

labels.label: UNCERTIFIED
labels.title: Missing bound, assumption or independent check

labels.label: UNSAFE
labels.title: An attack exceeds the claimed bound or targets

labels.label: CERTIFIED-NUMERIC
labels.title: Numeric bound with rigorous residual accounting

labels.label: DIGITIZED-FIGURE
labels.title: Read off a published figure; carries digitization error

labels.label: MEASURED-LATENCY
labels.title: Latency from real measurements

labels.label: MODELLED-LATENCY
labels.title: Latency from a model (light-cone, queue model); not a measurement

labels.label: MONTE-CARLO (lower bound)
labels.title: Sampled attack success: a LOWER bound on worst-case attack success, never an upper bound

labels.label: NUMERICAL
labels.title: Floating-point SDP solver output; not a proof without residual accounting

labels.label: PHOTON-EXPERIMENT
labels.title: Real recorded photon events with dataset hash

labels.label: PUBLISHED-AGGREGATE
labels.title: Number quoted from a paper table or text

labels.label: THEOREM
labels.title: Bound transcribed from a peer-reviewed proof

labels.label: QPU
labels.title: Actual quantum hardware job with job id

labels.label: SIMULATOR-IDEAL
labels.title: Noiseless circuit/statevector simulation

labels.label: SIMULATOR-NOISY
labels.title: Simulation under a declared noise model

labels.label: SYNTHETIC
labels.title: Generated fixture or hypothetical scenario

labels.label: UNCERTIFIED
labels.title: No applicable evidence
